name: Sonoluminescent Chrono-Geode Matrix
description: A colossal, infinitely shattering crystalline geode that fractures to reveal a violently erupting sonoluminescent plasma core. Fast-motion upgrade: closed-form orbital camera with eased time-warp spin, sonoluminescent flash-burst physics (bubble-collapse cycles with ballistic shockwave shells), bass kick bursts, and swirl-advected motion-blur trails. 2026-09-27: the shock front ignites and jolts the crystal walls as it passes, each collapse deposits a new agate stratum in the geode, and the core flash bleeds through thin shard walls.
